import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(district_counts))
bars2 = ax2.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index)
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Clean age data and create distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=20, ax=ax3, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f"Mean: {age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean():.1f} years")
ax3.legend()

# 4. Owner Age Group vs Dog Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation of owner age group and dog gender
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'])
# Sort by the order in the data
owner_age_order = df.sort_values('AlterV10Sort')['AlterV10Lang'].unique()
cross_tab = cross_tab.reindex([x for x in owner_age_order if x in cross_tab.index])

cross_tab.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='white', width=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Age Group', fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', loc='upper right')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
